\section{Normative notation and state axes}\label{sec:notation}

The words \textbf{shall}, \textbf{shall not}, \textbf{required}, and
\textbf{prohibited} are normative. ``Available'' means that every dependency
for the stated quantity is bound and valid. ``Unavailable'' means that the
quantity or claim has not been established; it never means numerical zero.
``Failed'' means that an authorized computation was attempted but did not
return a conforming result.

\begin{longtable}{@{}p{0.24\linewidth}p{0.69\linewidth}@{}}
\toprule
Symbol or term & Meaning \\
\midrule
\endhead
$m_q$ & Exact parent signal at admitted row or pixel $q$. \\
$\uvec_q$ & Physical coordinate supplied by the exact AltAz tangent-boundary transform for parent coordinate $p_q$. \\
$A$ & Fitted amplitude in the exact parent product's unit, calibration, and response. \\
$\boldsymbol{\mu}$ & Continuous fitted centroid in the declared ordered AltAz tangent basis. \\
$\Sigmashape$ & Symmetric positive-definite invariant Gaussian shape matrix. \\
$\boldsymbol{\theta}$ & The six scientific roles: amplitude, two centroid components, two principal-width roles, and orientation. \\
$\mathcal{P}$ & The complete data-dependent POINT procedure used to define a full-procedure response. \\
$P_{\mu}$ & Selector that extracts the two fitted-centroid components from the parameter vector. \\
$W_{\mathrm{fit}}$ & Exact fit-weight role, distinct from parent covariance, inverse covariance, reliability weight, and uncertainty products. \\
$\DeltaPoint$ & Measured source displacement, fitted centroid minus authoritative expected source position, in arcseconds in the declared basis. \\
parent & One exact observation-local, per-array MAP, JINC, FLT-FIXED, or FLT-MATCHED signal product. \\
terminal FRUIT ancestry & Lineage attached to one of the four parent families; it is not a fifth parent family. \\
named use & One owner-defined consumer purpose evaluated without changing the immutable POINT result. \\
\bottomrule
\end{longtable}

\subsection{Three independent state systems}\label{sec:state-axes}

Producer lifecycle, component identifiability, and named-use evaluation shall
remain independent.

\begin{description}[leftmargin=0.25\linewidth,style=multiline]
\item[Producer lifecycle]
\path{not_requested}, \path{requested}, \path{effective},
\path{unavailable}, \path{resolved}, \path{applied},
\path{fit_realized}, \path{complete_publication_candidate},
\path{publication_decided}, \path{published}, \path{failed},
\path{not_produced}, or \path{superseded}.
\item[Component identifiability]
Exactly one of \path{available_identifiable},
\path{available_bound_censored}, \path{weakly_identified},
\path{undefined_by_model_symmetry}, \path{unavailable}, or
\path{failed} for every required parameter role.
\item[Named-use evaluation]
Four fields, kept separate:\newline
request: \path{requested} or \path{not_requested};\newline
applicability: \path{applicable}, \path{inapplicable}, or
\path{applicability_unknown};\newline
eligibility: \path{eligible}, \path{ineligible}, or
\path{decision_unavailable};\newline
realization: \path{realized}, \path{incomplete}, \path{failed}, or
\path{not_produced}.
\end{description}

After the four named-use fields are evaluated, the owning consumer may
prescribe an action such as \path{diagnostic_display_only}. That token is
an action, not an eligibility value, producer state, or universal quality flag.
The token \path{diagnostic_only} is prohibited as a producer state or
SCI-VAL eligibility value. A generic product-availability field may use
\path{unavailable}; that token shall not be substituted into a SCI-VAL
realization field. Likewise, \path{decision_unavailable} is an eligibility
value only and shall not appear as applicability.

\subsection{Exact SCI-VAL disposition function}\label{sec:val-function}

For one named use, the evaluator shall apply the following precedence and
shall emit all four axes. An already realized producer fact is never erased by
the named-use disposition.

\small
\begin{longtable}{@{}p{0.24\linewidth}p{0.14\linewidth}p{0.18\linewidth}p{0.18\linewidth}p{0.16\linewidth}@{}}
\toprule
Controlling condition & Request & Applicability & Eligibility & Realization \\
\midrule
\endhead
Use not requested & \path{not_requested} & retained fact or \path{applicability_unknown} & \path{decision_unavailable} & \path{not_produced} \\
Missing profile or source binding & \path{requested} & \path{applicability_unknown} & \path{decision_unavailable} & \path{not_produced} \\
Structural profile/binding conflict & \path{requested} & \path{applicability_unknown} & \path{decision_unavailable} & \path{failed} \\
Use factually inapplicable & \path{requested} & \path{inapplicable} & \path{ineligible} & \path{not_produced} \\
Applicable, artifact incomplete & \path{requested} & \path{applicable} & \path{decision_unavailable} & \path{incomplete} \\
Applicable, artifact failed & \path{requested} & \path{applicable} & \path{decision_unavailable} & \path{failed} \\
Applicable, artifact not produced & \path{requested} & \path{applicable} & \path{decision_unavailable} & \path{not_produced} \\
Applicable and policy-evaluable & \path{requested} & \path{applicable} & \path{eligible} or \path{ineligible} & \path{realized}, \path{incomplete}, \path{failed}, or \path{not_produced}, as observed \\
\bottomrule
\end{longtable}
\normalsize

Every row also carries the exact controlling cause, profile identity, source
bindings, evaluation identity, lifecycle, provenance, and any prescribed
post-evaluation action. Missing-source means a missing source authority or
source binding required by that exact use; it does not delete an otherwise
conforming unassociated fit component.
